item.title: How to Read NFP, CPI and Other News Data When Trading Gold
item.description: Forecast, actual and previous: how to read the NFP jobs report, CPI inflation and FOMC for gold, with 16 years of data on how much bigger jobs-report days really are.

item.title: Gold Outlook Scorecard: Every Forecast, Scored in Public
item.description: Every gold forecast we make, saved before the day and scored after it, with the back-test, calibration charts and the misses included.

item.title: How Our Gold Outlook Works: The Method, the Maths and Its Limits
item.description: How we turn 16 years of gold prices into daily odds, ranges and level probabilities, what we test, what the back-test found and what the method cannot do.

item.title: How Much Does Gold Move in a Day? 16 Years of XAUUSD Data
item.description: A typical gold day moves about half a percent, but one day in four moves over 1%. See 16 years of daily XAUUSD volatility, the biggest days and what it means for your stop loss.
